name: Nuclear risk
summary: No US–Russia arms-control limits; Russian nuclear warnings over Kaliningrad; North Korean launches
state: New START expired in February 2026 with no replacement. Russia threatened in late September to use nuclear weapons if NATO acted against Kaliningrad, and Lithuania passed the first of three votes on 6 Oct to lift its ban on hosting nuclear weapons (Arms Control Association). North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov (US News). No nuclear test or change in alert levels had been reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect for most people. In the UK, official emergency guidance is published at gov.uk/prepare.
rubric_hit: Explicit threats and arms-control lapse without replacement = Watch; no test or alert change

sources.title: Arms Control Association — Russia issues nuclear threats over Kaliningrad
US News (Reuters) — North Korea fires multiple missiles in fourth weapons launch in a month

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
